Generation is an opaque equality token. Incrementing and decrementing both distinguish obsolete asynchronous completions from the current activation.

With bounded nonnegative counters, Math.max(null, b) equals b; when both counters are null the retained b-null branch returns null.
With bounded nonnegative counters, Math.max(a, null) equals a; when a is null the retained a-null branch returns b unchanged.

Within transported JSON, required fields reject primitives and the separate array guard rejects arrays. Removing the object typeof clause does not admit another JSON result.
